results.title: Every input/select/textarea has an accessible name (all pages)
Every button/link has an accessible name
<html lang> is set and exactly one <h1> per page
Workspace: all 7 steps have labelled inputs and named buttons
Stepper button accessible names read naturally ("Problem, complete" not "Problem(complete)")
Interactive controls are at least 24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 min) on every step
Text contrast >= 4.5:1 (3:1 large) on all pages (desktop)
Keyboard focus is visibly indicated on buttons, links, inputs (outline or ring)
Dashboard main controls reachable by Tab: New investigation, Open, Duplicate, Delete, Reset sample
Cause tree: boxes reachable and selectable by keyboard (Tab + Enter), toolbar then reachable
Confirm dialog: focus moves into it, Escape closes, focus returns to trigger
After closing the dialog with Escape focus returns to the button that opened it
Skip link / landmarks: page has a <main> landmark on dashboard and workspace
Accessibility: names, labels, headings, language, titles, focus visibility, keyboard reach, contrast
